intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정해서 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Independently choose and render a complex randomized speculative-science photographic concept, using the attached image only to stabilize facial appearance, then evaluate how faithfully the composed prompt and generated pixels realize the frozen concept.

Create a photorealistic square environmental portrait of one clearly adult original woman in a flooded lunar archive refitted as a pressure-safe domestic study. She stands head to knees beside a transparent instrument cabinet, decoding a palm-sized storm trapped inside it by aligning three copper tuning rings; branching lightning responds visibly to her gloved fingertips. A miniature aurora folds horizontally through the room at her waist, scattering glacial-cyan light over ankle-deep water, smoke-glass shelves, waterlogged paper capsules, and oxidized copper fixtures. Her structured black-and-copper observatory uniform has a close collar, articulated sleeves, and a precisely cinched midsection over a gently shaped hip line, fully practical and fully clothed. Give her the stable facial appearance indicated by the reference image while depicting an original fictional person; keep her face, natural mouth contour, and focused expression crisply legible. Use eye-level 50 mm perspective, realistic wet reflections, fine skin and fabric texture, restrained atmospheric haze, and a quiet scientifically plausible interior mood. Key visual priorities are the readable storm-cabinet interaction, the waist-height aurora boundary, and coherent facial appearance.

obligation.composition_instruction: Establish a familiar physically coherent scene through clean photographic capture, select exactly one world invariant to fail, and include a clear normal control state against which the violation can be compared. Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Within every affected region, preserve the source surface's native material identity, local texture, thickness, lighting, depth, boundary shape, and occlusion while the chosen rule changes its coordinates or correspondence; the error must follow the three-dimensional scene rather than cut and move a flat image plane. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary. Choose a deliberate reveal strength: either an immediate authored contradiction or a quiet second-look contradiction. In either mode, it must read as one integrated world system rather than a visible effect shell, portal, particle dissolve, or generic image failure.

The contradiction appears at the deliberately selected reveal strength, immediate or delayed, while remaining clearly authored, subordinate to one inferable world rule, and distinguishable from generic image failure.

Without prompt text, a caption, or metadata, a viewer can state the single failed world rule and point to at least three separated instances that share its same measurable relation; merely saying that something looks wrong fails.
An isolated malformed hand or face, fused object, broken texture or text, accidental reflection or shadow mismatch, or other familiar synthesis defect does not carry the reality-error concept.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
